Licensed Pro Hero.name: Licensed Pro Hero
Licensed Pro Hero.description:
🏢 You run your own small hero agency on Musutafu's Hero Agency Row: your hero name on the door, one sidekick and a ranking to climb.

⚖️ Fully licensed from the first scene. You may patrol, arrest villains, hire sidekicks and supervise hero students on workplace experience.
⚠️ Rent is due every month, and property damage or excessive force brings complaints, lawsuits and lost sponsors that your agency pays for.
🤝 Your sidekick, rival agencies on the same street (Death Arms, Backdraft, Gunhead, Fourth Kind), the police, the press and the Hero Billboard Chart.
🔓 Learnable later: Name on the Door, Team-Up Request.

📈 Grants: Power +1, Hero Industry +10, Leadership +10, Media Presence +5
⚡ Starting technique: Agency Dispatch
🎒 Starts with: Agency hero costume, Agency radio, Agency phone, Business cards, Capture tape, Duffel bag, Casual clothes, ¥80,000
Licensed Pro Hero.traitNarrativeEffects:
Legal status: fully licensed pro hero (Hero License trait added at start), small agency on Musutafu's Hero Agency Row; not U.A. faculty. Commission rules: Quirk use in hero work and emergencies, arrests for police, hiring sidekicks, contracts, supervising student workplace experience. Damage or excess force: complaints, inquiries, suits, lost sponsors; agency pays.
Access: office, shared Row rooms and radio, crime scenes, Commission app, police, support, agency contacts.
Obligations: rent, insurance, sidekick pay, patrols, reports, statements, court, audits, sponsor rules; Hero Billboard Chart: arrests, rescues, complaints all count.
Who notices: sidekick; Row rivals Death Arms, Backdraft, Gunhead, Fourth Kind; Kamui Woods, Mount Lady; police, Naomasa Tsukauchi on League cases; press, fans.
Standing pressures: rank and contracts make or break agencies; pros scout students at the Sports Festival; Stain the Hero Killer is loose; big operations draft nearby agencies.
